description: This simulation model utilizes a multi-agent framework to replicate user behavior in rating and reviewing items on different platforms. The model is designed to evaluate the capabilities of LLM-based agents in generating coherent and contextually appropriate reviews and preference ratings.

behaviors.name: write_review
behaviors.description: Simulates the user writing a review based on product interaction.
behaviors.algorithm: LLM-based review generation using user and item attributes

behaviors.name: give_star_rating
behaviors.description: Simulates the user providing a star rating for a product.
behaviors.algorithm: LLM-based star rating prediction using user and item attributes

behaviors.name: reason_review
behaviors.description: Uses LLM to analyze and generate a review based on user behavior and item attributes.
behaviors.algorithm: LLM reasoning based on user profile and item data

behaviors.name: reason_star_rating
behaviors.description: Uses LLM to predict a star rating based on user behavior and item attributes.
behaviors.algorithm: LLM reasoning to predict star rating

interactions.name: User_Product_Review
interactions.description: User writes a review and gives a star rating to a product.
interactions.effect: Product receives new review and rating

interactions.name: LLM_Reasoning
interactions.description: LLM agent reasons about the review and star rating provided by the user.

files.name: main.py
files.description: Main simulation script that initializes and runs the simulation

files.name: agents.py
files.description: Defines the User, Product, and LLM_Agent classes

files.name: interactions.py
files.description: Defines the interactions between agents and products

files.name: environment.py
files.description: Sets up the simulation environment and network

files.name: data_loader.py
files.description: Loads and preprocesses data from JSON files
